# Vast FFmpeg distribution

Vast builds the Windows FFmpeg and FFprobe executables used by Video & Audio
from pinned source. The release configuration intentionally enables GPLv3 mode
because Avidae's public capability contract depends on x264 presets, CRF quality
control and low-latency H.264 encoding in recording, compression, conversion,
trim and merge workflows.

The runtime is not covered by Vast's MIT license. It is a separate GPLv3-or-later
program invoked as a child process. Every public Vast release that contains the
runtime must distribute the exact corresponding-source archive generated by the
same build and must pass `npm run ffmpeg:release:check` against the files that
will actually ship.

The authoritative source and toolchain lock is `ffmpeg-build.lock.json`. No
release build may substitute a Gyan, BtbN, system PATH or other untracked binary.

See [BUILD.md](BUILD.md) for reproduction and verification instructions.
